name: 3d-pin
title: 3D Pin Card
description: A dark link card holding an avatar, a name, a short paragraph and tag pills. Hovering tips it into perspective, fades in a site-name pill above and pulses blue rings behind a thin cyan stem.
use: A project or profile card should feel interactive and reveal a destination link on hover.
avoid: Touch devices or tight layouts: the effect needs hover and a wide overlay area.
a11y: It is a real link, but the pill, rings and pin appear on hover only, so keyboard focus never reveals them and adds no focus ring. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A small near-black rounded card with a barely visible border, holding a violet-to-sky gradient circle, the bold name Aceternity UI, a grey paragraph and three thin outlined tags in a row along the bottom. Hovered, it tilts away under a small dark pill reading aceternity.com, joined by a fine cyan line.
behaves: At rest the card faces the viewer. On hover it tips back in perspective, shrinks slightly and darkens toward its top edge, a site-name pill fades in above, a cyan pin line and dot appear, and soft blue rings pulse out behind it on a six-second loop. Leaving restores the flat card.
customise: The card body comes in as children; title and href feed the hover pill and the link. className and containerClassName restyle it, while the tilt angle, rings and pin are fixed in the source.
weight: light: One card, a single hover transform and three small rings looping.
demo: Name Aceternity UI, a short paragraph, and tags UI, React and Next.js under an aceternity.com title.
issues: Hover-only: touch and keyboard users never see the site pill, rings or cyan beam.
The card border is almost invisible against the black stage until hovered.
polishWhy: Crisp perspective tilt and pin detail, but the faint border and hover-only reveal are misses.
